worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = IRA distribution (person 0) 40,000.00 + military retirement pay (person 0) 60,000.00 = 100,000.00. Federal taxable income = 100,000.00 - 23,625.00 federal standard deduction - 1 x 2,000.00 age 65 additional = 74,375.00 (the federal senior deduction is ignored). Form 40 (filing status head of household): line 7 federal AGI 100,000.00. Line 8 additions 0.00; line 9 = 100,000.00 + 0.00 = 100,000.00. Form 39R Part B line 7 Social Security and railroad benefits included in federal income = 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00. Line 8 retirement benefits deduction: line 8a 48,216.00 (the booklet prints no figure for head of household, so the projection's fallback (single)); line 8b railroad benefits received 0.00; line 8c Social Security received (gross, both spouses, Box 5) 0.00; line 8d = 48,216.00 - 0.00 - 0.00, not below zero, = 48,216.00; line 8e (person 0 age 66: 60,000.00 qualifies, age 62 or older) = 60,000.00; line 8f smaller of 8d and 8e = 48,216.00. Line 18 health insurance premiums: none in the inputs, 0.00. Line 24 total subtractions = 0.00 + 48,216.00 = 48,216.00. Form 40 line 10 48,216.00; line 11 total adjusted income = 100,000.00 - 48,216.00 = 51,784.00. Line 12a boxes checked 1. Standard Deduction Worksheet: line 1 23,625.00; line 4 23,625.00; line 5 1 x 2,000.00 = 2,000.00; line 6 25,625.00. Line 15 0.00 (no Schedule A); line 16 25,625.00. Line 17 = 51,784.00 - 25,625.00 = 26,159.00. Line 18 federal Form 1040 lines 13a and 13b taken as 0.00; line 19 Idaho taxable income 26,159.00. Line 20 worksheet: line 1 26,159.00; line 2 9,622.00; line 3 = 16,537.00; line 4 at 5.3%; line 5 tax = 16,537.00 x 5.3% = 876.461, to the cent 876.46 (the return rounds to whole dollars, PDF p.8, and shows 876; expected keeps the formula). Lines 21-24 credits 0.00; line 25 0.00; line 26 876.46. Food Tax Credit Worksheet (Form 40 line 43): 1 x 155.00 = 155.00. State income tax = 876.46 - 155.00 = 721.46. Line 31 Permanent Building Fund tax 10.00 is on the return but the projection does not charge it (approximations). Line 18 would take any federal Schedule 1-A amount, the senior deduction included; it is ignored here and the projection does not subtract it (approximations).
accepted_approximations: The retirement maximum prints for single and joint only. A head of household, qualifying surviving spouse or married filing separately return has no printed figure; the projection gives only the two printed amounts, so such a return needs the fallback a status not given takes for brackets (single; joint for a qualifying surviving spouse).
The Permanent Building Fund tax of 10 a return (Form 40 line 31) is not charged.
The federal Schedule 1-A and qualified business income deductions are not subtracted (Form 40 line 18).
